issue: धवल कमल दल मम तनु साजे: मम ('my') sits oddly in a description of the Gaṅgā; the book and Drik Panchang both print it. सम ('like') would fit the line and its second half.
our reading: मम as printed (the plain reading): white lotus petals adorn my body; seeing it, a hundred autumn moons are put to shame.
alternatives: मम read as सम: 'your body is adorned like the petals of a white lotus'.

issue: मिलै भक्ति अविरल वागीसा: वागीसा is read as the reader becoming 'lord of speech' (vāgīśa); the half has no verb for it.
our reading: gains unbroken devotion and becomes a master of speech.
alternatives: unbroken devotion from Vāgīśa (Brahmā or Sarasvatī); or 'devotion to the lord of speech'.

issue: सम्वत् भुज नभ दिशि … नैत्र: a year in number-words (भुज 2, नभ 0, दिशि 10 or 4 or 8), read right to left in the usual way; it does not give a plausible Vikrama year as printed. नैत्र ('eye', also the number-word 2) ends the dohā.
our reading: In the year arm, sky, direction (the words kept), on Rāma's birthday in Caitra, completed for the good of Hari's devotees, as an eye for them.
alternatives: नैत्र as part of the year (2); दिशि as 4 or 8.
